articles.title: Revolut hackers demand $3 million in Monero, threaten to sell customer data
articles.snippet: The group gave Revolut 24 hours to pay and said it targeted customers with significant crypto holdings.

articles.title: Bitcoin Core 32 enters final testing with faster validation, fee changes and security fixes
articles.snippet: The October update changes how nodes estimate transaction fees and process blocks, while fixing a wallet flaw that could let an authenticated user run commands on a node.

articles.title: Deutsche Bank close to debuting crypto custody for institutions
articles.snippet: The service will support a select range of cryptocurrencies at debut, including bitcoin and ether and stablecoins like USDC and EURC.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin steady as stocks slide following Fed rate hike, Warsh press conference
articles.snippet: Privacy token zcash, meanwhile, is up 130% over 30 days and trades near its all-time highs from 2016.

articles.title: Ethereum, Base give up on common wallet standard after months of talks
articles.snippet: Ethereum is moving ahead with EIP-8141 while Coinbase-backed Base backs EIP-8130, leaving wallets and apps that span both networks facing different transaction systems.
